title: Quiz: Past Simple vs. Past Progressive
instructions: The quiz starts easy and gets harder. The early parts are worth the most points, so do them carefully first.

questions.title: Part A · Choose the correct form (40 points, 4 each)
questions.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
At 9 o'clock last night I ___ a film.
Last summer we ___ to Eilat for a week.
They ___ playing cards when the lights went out.
I didn't ___ you at the party.
While she ___, the phone rang.
Did you ___ your homework?
I ___ the answer, but I didn't say anything.
He opened the door, ___ on the light and sat down.
When the teacher came in, the students ___ so loudly that nobody heard her.
I was walking home ___ it started to rain.

questions.title: Part B · Complete the story (30 points, 3 each)
questions.prompt:
Write the verbs in the Past Simple or the Past Progressive.

Last Tuesday our class (1) ___ (go) on a trip to the Galilee. When we (2) ___ (arrive), it (3) ___ (rain), so we (4) ___ (decide) to stay on the bus. While we (5) ___ (sit) there, our teacher (6) ___ (start) to tell us funny stories about her first school trip. Suddenly, the driver (7) ___ (shout), "Look!" A family of deer (8) ___ (cross) the road in front of us. We (9) ___ (not / have) a camera, but everyone (10) ___ (take) photos with their phones.
(1) go
(2) arrive
(3) rain
(4) decide
(5) sit
(6) start
(7) shout
(8) cross
(9) not / have
(10) take

questions.title: Part C · Find and fix the mistake (20 points, 4 each)
questions.prompt: Four sentences have one mistake. One sentence is correct. Write the correct sentence. If the sentence is already correct, write: correct
When I was arrive at school, the bell was ringing.
accepted: When I arrived at school, the bell was ringing.

questions.prompt: Where you were going at 8 o'clock last night?
accepted: Where were you going at 8 o'clock last night?
Where were you going at eight o'clock last night?

questions.prompt: While we were playing football, it was starting to rain.
accepted: While we were playing football, it started to rain.

questions.prompt: I was having dinner when you called.
She was wanting a new phone for her birthday.
accepted: She wanted a new phone for her birthday.

questions.title: Part D · Write it yourself (10 points)
questions.prompt: D1. Make one sentence with when or while. Choose the tenses yourself.
my brother / sleep → the fire alarm / go off
questions.modelAnswer:
My brother was sleeping when the fire alarm went off. / The fire alarm went off while my brother was sleeping.
2 points: both tenses right. 1 point: one verb wrong or a form error. 0: both wrong.

questions.prompt: I / do my homework → my parents / watch the news
questions.modelAnswer:
While I was doing my homework, my parents were watching the news. ("When I was doing…, my parents were watching…" is acceptable.)
2 points: both tenses right. 1 point: one verb wrong or a form error. 0: both wrong.

questions.title: D2. Yesterday at 7:30 a.m. (6 points)
questions.prompt: Write three sentences about your home yesterday at 7:30 a.m. Describe what people were doing, and one thing that happened. Use when or while at least once.
questions.modelAnswer:
At 7:30 my mum was making coffee and my sister was looking for her shoes. My dad was reading the news on his phone. While I was eating breakfast, the cat jumped on the table and knocked over my juice.

Rubric: Past Progressive describing the scene (2) · Past Simple for something that happened (2) · when/while used correctly (1) · three sentences, no form errors (1).
